analyzer: ArabicMorphAnalyzer (rule-based, stdlib-only; NOT a trained model)

gold.source: Q-CSMP v2 test split (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23024527, CC-BY-4.0); roots trace to Quranic Arabic Corpus annotation
gold.excluded: 35 test records with no triliteral root (particles e.g. LIAOLAA) — excluded, not counted as misses
gold.normalization: diacritics stripped + hamza normalized on BOTH wordform and gold root, exactly as the analyzer does internally
gold.pattern: NOT SCORED — Q-CSMP v2 does not annotate the coarse pattern vocabulary

failure_analysis.note: analyzer prefix tables use U+0627 alef; Quranic U+0671 superscript-alef forms never match — 0/40 on those

verdict: 34.9% root accuracy — weak baseline on Quranic orthography. #1 fix: U+0671 normalization in the analyzer. No trained-model claim.
